headline: Next Xbox could cost up to $1,800, Microsoft reportedly projects
summary: Microsoft is reportedly projecting a price of $1,200 to $1,800 for its next-generation Xbox, Project Helix, targeting a 2028 release, according to details from a profile with Xbox's CEO. The company is also said to be planning its own gaming handheld for release next year.

claims.statement: Microsoft reportedly projects its next-gen Xbox could cost between $1,200 and $1,800, targeting a 2028 release.
